scope.summary: Flaky write_auth_invalid_grant_never_falls_back_to_elevated_session root-caused as a test defect, not a fail-open: the tamper step replaced the last hex digit with 0, a no-op for ~1/16 references, so a valid grant was submitted; even then the failure mode was a refusal before any DB I/O. Test-only fix (452742b3): tamper always changes the digit; new deterministic tests.
out_of_scope: No production change was needed or made.

entry_points.name: workspace gate at 32504f70 (clean worktree, lease)
entry_points.trace: write_auth_invalid_grant_never_falls_back_to_elevated_session ok; write_auth_tamper_never_returns_the_valid_reference ok (reproduces the old no-op tamper deterministically); write_auth_every_tampered_tag_digit_is_refused_as_mismatch ok (all 64 signature digits refused as GRANT_MISMATCH before DB access). The gate had 9 unrelated failures on read/query/CQN paths from b3f3f360 (FGA evidence), routed to their owners.

entry_points.name: implementer loop proof
entry_points.trace: Pre-fix: 14/200 failures, all at the tampered-grant step with GRANT_ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE / NotStarted / zero DB I/O. Post-fix: 0/200 for the test and its module at default threads and --test-threads=1.

entry_points.name: gate self-weakening review (orchestrator)
entry_points.trace: Diff is test-only; no retry wrapper, #[ignore], or weakened assertion; the tamper is made strictly stronger.

limitations: The 200-iteration loop was run by the implementing pane; the orchestrator re-ran the suite once in the clean gate, not the loop.
